name: Dubai International Airport

runway.v: two parallel runways; the longer, 12R/30L, is 4,447 m long and 60 m wide (12L/30R is 4,351 m x 60 m)

hours.v: open 24 hours, with air traffic services, fuel and handling 24 hours
hours.quote: AD Administration: H24 ... Air Traffic Services: H24 ... Handling: H24

slots.v: a fully slot-coordinated (IATA level 3) airport: no flight without a slot from the coordinator and landing permission from the Dubai Civil Aviation Authority
slots.quote: OMDB operates as an IATA level 3 slot coordinated airport. No operator shall operate to or from OMDB without first obtaining an allocated slot from Airport Coordination Limited (ACL)

handling.v: Jet Aviation and ExecuJet are the only FBOs handling general aviation; operators must contract one of them, and slot requests go through the FBO
handling.quote: Jet Aviation and Execujet Aviation Group are the sole FBOs providing ground handling services for GA aircraft at the Airport.

max_aircraft.v: the largest aircraft (code F) must apply for schedule clearance at least 72 hours before arrival
max_aircraft.quote: must apply for schedule clearance at least seventy-two (72) hours prior to the intended arrival

noise.v: aircraft without noise certification to the ICAO Annex 16 standards may not operate to or from Dubai International
noise.quote: aircraft not in possession of noise certification in accordance with the standards of Annex 16 ... are not permitted to operate to/from OMDB

missing: curfew (AIP shows H24 but no explicit 'no night restriction'; GA has daily restricted periods, see notable)
ppr (beyond slot and DCAA landing permission)
notes: GA restricted periods are in UTC; Dubai is UTC+4 all year (no daylight saving), so local they are 04:30-06:29, 07:30-11:59, 14:30-18:29 (not Mondays), 23:00-01:29 and 03:00-04:59. The source table did not extract cleanly: it is not certain whether each period applies to arrivals, departures or both (totals 8.5 and 10.5 hours suggest separate arrival/departure columns), so do not publish these as a curfew or as exact windows without re-checking the PDF. The Conditions of Use found is Northern Winter 2025 (effective 26 Oct 2025); a Winter 2026 edition may now apply. The AIP AD 2 OMDB PDF used is from the 2026-P06 package with pages up to AIRAC 08/2026; later AIRACs (P09-P11) were not readable as text.
